--------------
-- CETAS
--------------


CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_cetas
WITH 
(
    LOCATION= 'cetas_revenue',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_ext_source1,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
)
AS
SELECT 
      * 
FROM 
     OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'revenue',
        DATA_SOURCE= 'raw_ext_source1',
        FORMAT= 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        HEADER_ROW= TRUE
     ) as query1
